title: AWS Pre-sales (Ref: JL)
job_description:
Education Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, or a related field. Master’s degree or MBA is a plus. Experience 5–8 years of experience in cloud solution architecture, IT consulting, system integration, or pre-sales engineering, with hands-on involvement in AWS-based projects. Technical Skills Strong knowledge of core AWS services (Compute, Storage, Networking, Security, Data & Analytics) and experience designing secure, scalable cloud architectures. Pre-Sales Capability Experience supporting sales with technical proposals, customer presentations, solution documentation, and cost estimations (including TCO discussions). Communication Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and collaborate with internal teams and AWS partners.

1. Technical Proposal & AWS Solution Architecture Design Gather and analyze customers’ current system environments and business/technical challenges Design optimal AWS cloud architectures (Migration, Modernization, Security, Data & Analytics, DevOps, etc.) Prepare system architecture diagrams, technical proposals, and solution documentation 2. Sales Support & Customer-Facing Technical Engagement Lead the technical aspects of proposal activities in collaboration with sales teams Conduct technical discussions with customers, gather requirements, and respond to technical inquiries Provide technical support for proposal presentations and Proof of Concept (PoC) initiatives 3. Cost Estimation & Cloud Optimization Proposals Prepare high-level WS cost estimations Perform Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) comparisons between on-premises and cloud environments Propose cost optimization strategies using Reserved Instances, Savings Plans, and other AWS pricing models 4. Technical Risk Assessment & Feasibility Validation Assess the technical feasibility of proposed solutions Identify migration complexity, constraints, and system dependencies Evaluate alignment with security and compliance requirements 5. Collaboration with Delivery Teams & Handover Provide technical handover of the solution design to delivery teams after project award Continue to support complex projects as a technical advisor when required

EPF SOCSO Annual Leave Medical Leave Health Insurance

AWS Pre Sales
